hypothesis: The Rust-only allocator experiment leaves DATA/FRONTIER DirectBuf allocations on libc. A full mimalloc process comparison must route those 4096-aligned allocations through the chosen Rust allocator too; v7 large DATA and per-sync FRONTIER allocations can then benefit.
change: Retain the opt-in mimalloc-allocator feature and use std::alloc::{alloc,dealloc} with matching Layout(capacity,4096) for DirectBuf only when enabled. Keep the original libc posix_memalign/free path when disabled. Preserve capacity, initialized-byte contract, ownership, pooling and CQE lifetimes. Build fresh System and mimalloc-aligned binaries from identical final source.
build: cargo build --release --package kv-engine --features bench[,mimalloc-allocator] --bin write-perf; freeze separate System and mimalloc-aligned binaries. No C allocator override or runtime tuning.
protocol: Audited four-arm paired comparison: System v4,mimalloc v4,System v7,mimalloc v7 on odd rounds;reverse on even. Four unscored warmups. 1KiB values,2GiB SST target;100K point operations or750K batch64;latency every100 point or10 batches. Include all stalled runs;no builds/tests/profiles during scoring. One-second host-process and child RSS samples;RSS covers the complete child lifetime and is not measured-interval-only. Keep raw and normalized ratios; allocator benefits to v4 count as benefits, not a regression in the v7-specific ratio.
cooldown: tmpfs3s between runs;SSD30s before eachcell and10s between runs.
gates: For each format and each cell: median paired raw and ratio of arm medians >=0.95,CPU ratio <=1.05; p99 ratio <=1.10 for SSD and solo. At least one cell/format gains >=2% raw with CPU ratio<=1.0. RSS is reported; investigate lifetime peak RSS >1.20x before retention. Normalized v7/v4 is diagnostic since both formats change allocator.
confirmation: If initial complete matrix passes, exactly five additional SSD pairs each workload and three further RAM pairs each cell, same settings. Pool only this allocator source/policy and reevaluate gates; no further attempts chosen by score.
decision: Evaluate this combined allocator policy independently with the same complete matrix and fixed guards. Do not pool Rust-only and aligned-buffer captures or attribute differences across matrices solely to aligned buffers. If this policy fails its initial guards, cancel confirmation and do not adopt it as default.
prerequisite: Finish the current Rust-only allocator matrix before any Rust edit, build, test, profile or new scored run.
sanitizer_compatibility: Keep sanitizer builds on the System allocator using the pinned nightly cfg_sanitize feature; normal scored configurations still use the selected allocator. Check this before freezing the second policy binaries.
